decisions.reason: A quantified government reference, close fit with core travel-security operations, and a dedicated webpage make management highly likely to continue backing it.
Even without published results, its standalone presentation and direct link to travel-compliance services encourage management to persist and explain slow uptake as temporary.
The training module builds on the firm's established training capabilities and is relatively easy to sustain, so management is likely to keep developing demand for it.
Behaviour analysis supports the firm's stated move toward higher-value integrated security solutions, which makes management reluctant to abandon it after investing in it.
Its dedicated page, close adjacency to document and travel-security services, and likely reusable development investment favor continued support rather than withdrawal.
